analysis.method: stdlib JSON/gzip/hash processing and read-only git; no product code

candidate_historical_occurrences.label: historical measurements, not a savings measurement or authorized removal
candidate_historical_occurrences.pair_record_note: Every selected turn is copied unchanged as a parsed JSON object from raw observation.advances[ordinal]; identities/hashes are not normalized.
candidate_historical_occurrences.scope: only final Finish.done application followed by parent finish-to-recording promotion

measured_historical.control_index_note: A complete ordinal index, not a replacement for the lossless raw. Parent phase frame is rendered as public progress phase source by _checkpoint_progress.

limits: One instrumented Native-only observation; no timing baseline, throughput, peak memory, or parallelism measurement.
Fixture construction and ordinary oracle validation include real Native work; their raw disposable SQLite has no admitted-SQL coverage here.
Method scopes and retained DBAPI leaves include instrumentation overhead. Inclusive times overlap; only exclusive same-thread scopes are disjoint within their enclosing stages.
Admitted DBAPI leaf intervals include original admission/currentness checks and driver work, not isolated SQLite engine time or database-wait attribution.
execute/executemany/executescript are separate leaf-attempt kinds; executemany parameters are never consumed for counting. Returned rows are not engine row visits.

Commit/rollback counters cover explicit methods only; implicit context-manager transactions are outside that counter. executescript is one DBAPI attempt, not its expanded statements; the SQL table label is only a surface classifier.
read_window calls the maintained source read_exact; nested exact reads are explicitly labeled and must not be added again to window bytes.
Exception families belong only to this probe. Historical 931f01e Core catalog 418 raised attempts remain unclassified.

The cooperative 120-second cap prevents further work at safe boundaries. An entered synchronous owner call is not force-closed and may return after the cap. Original cleanup/join may also finish later; there is no hard-kill promise.

reported_new_diagnostics.interpretation: Reports only; inclusive function times overlap. No same-run pair or throughput comparison, no fsync/wait attribution, no completion inference from the partial correction prefix and no causal saving estimate.

blocking_contracts: When and how the completed child checkpoint/digest stops being authoritative, including deletion/replacement after commit, before another public return.
Mapping of durable parent versions, public progress and Core per-step adoption/readiness/stamp/scheduling opportunities for the removed promotion boundary.
Exact rollback, reply-loss, reopen, stale-worker and original resource receiving outcomes for the terminal child/parent publication.

hypothetical_admission.phase_policy: one existing child prepare/application plus at most one terminal parent-state promotion, not an unconstrained loop or a larger semantic quantum
hypothetical_admission.row_and_octet_policy: one unchanged admitted plan; no restart of _start or residual budget and no additional semantic phase; any completion-proof work needs its own actual control-byte/callback envelope before admission

static_and_proposed.rank_counterexample_scope: Defeats broader Native loops. The pure promotion then immediate return still performs the full Core readiness chain before a later recording call; it changes promotion timing, not proof of invalid archive acceptance.
static_and_proposed.status: leave implementation out pending Native completion-discharge and Core observation contracts
static_and_proposed.total_growth_limit: Correction still seeds every active effective assertion and repeats generic/row/finish checks; tiny zero-adjacency inputs establish no whole-path growth closure, memory bound or constant-cost claim.
